loze / is Stage Of

is Stage Of

Property

The relation that obtains between two eventualities e and e' if and only if e is a stage or phase in the occurrence of e'

https://loze-ontology.org/isStageOf

For example

The construction of the foundations of a house is a stage of the construction of the whole house, the preparation of the dough is a stage in the making of a pizza, the positioning of the explosive is a stage in the demolition of a building, the fermentation of the must is a stage in the production of wine

Note

Given an eventuality e and a period of time t, e can have at the most one stage that occurs from the start to the end of t

loze is a top-level ontology after E. J. Lowe's four-category ontology, with Zemach's schematic particulars. Every term here is identified by an IRI under https://loze-ontology.org/.
